findings.title: Soft required ("please fill in" warning) not expressible in DSL
findings.description: XML4DR marks ~50 input cells with FieldFilled(obThis) severity=warning. The DSL only has required true/false, so these are required:false and the nudge is lost.
findings.proposedFix: Add a required level (none|warn|error) to the DSL and compile warn to a non-blocking validation.

findings.title: DSL stricter than source on required
findings.description: DSL has required:true where XML4DR has no required check (A contact fields, I, C10 and two radios).
findings.proposedFix: Relax to the source behaviour (or soft-required once F-002 exists) unless SSB confirms the stricter rule.

findings.title: Conditional visibility on cells that are always visible calculated cells in the source
findings.description: DSL hides row 2.1/2.2 cells behind a 'row-2 total > 0' condition; in XML4DR these cells are dark-grey calculated and always visible.
findings.proposedFix: Drop the condition on calculated cells; keep it only where XML guidance handlers gate input cells.

findings.title: Conditional gating present in source but missing in DSL
findings.description: XML guidance handlers gate a few cells (C3 VB2021_4/6, C12 V2016_36/37) that are always shown in the DSL.
findings.proposedFix: Add the matching visibility conditions in the DSL.

findings.title: DSL-only cross-field constraints (own invariants)
findings.description: DSL adds behandlet<=mottatt, ikkeNegativ, overFrist, samsvar, treUker, mangelfulle constraints with error severity that have no XML4DR check of the same shape.
findings.proposedFix: Decide per family: keep as deliberate improvements (document), downgrade to warning to match the source, or remove.

findings.title: Source-only plausibility and format checks missing in DSL
findings.description: XML4DR warns on telephone range, e-mail format, B1 > 50000, herav > total, and cross-section comparisons (C10 vs C2), plus empty-vs-zero warnings in C4.
findings.proposedFix: Add format constraint types (email, phone) and warning-level herav<=total and cross-bolk constraints.

findings.title: Calculation inputs differ (copy chains and C14 totals)
findings.description: XML calculations read other bolks directly (C14 from C10/C11/C12/C13, row totals from sub-rows) while the DSL sums its own columns.
findings.proposedFix: Re-express the DSL calculations from the source inputs; verify numerically in the simulator.

findings.title: Strandsone (coastal municipality) flag gates D1 question 3 in the source
findings.description: Section13/VB2019_2 (Strandsone, 1=ja/0=nei) is prefilled per municipality. Source: D1 row 3 (Section_E1/V2012_7 and its row) is readonly when 0, and a warning asks for a number when 1. DSL has no municipality flag, so row 3 is always open and never nudged.
findings.proposedFix: Add a prefilled/context flag (e.g. coastal municipality) usable in conditions, then gate D1 q3 and add the fill-in warning for coastal municipalities.
